acceptance_criteria.statement: Runtime and schema define one explicit externalRead grammar and consistently reject dotted-tail IPv6.
Tests pin the complete externalRead schema subtree exactly and use no partial general-purpose schema interpreter.
A shared corpus covers accepted DNS/IP values and all specified URL-like, whitespace, zone-id, bracketed, malformed, and method rejects.
All compiled grant containers, including nested modelPolicy state, are detached immutable copies with controlled failure for unsupported values.
Missing fields remain compatible, canonicalization is deterministic, full Node tests and diff checks pass, and only allowed paths change.
